public_body: Belmont Middle And High School Building Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair's pre-meeting email of reports and documents fell within the distribution exemption, and posting documents with notice is not required.

allegations.summary: Chair emailed committee members meeting documents before an April 13 meeting, allegedly a deliberation outside a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, the Chair’s April 11 email fits within the narrow exemption to the definition of deliberation and was simply the distribution of reports or documents for the purpose of discussion during the April 13 meeting.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly did not simultaneously post the pre-meeting materials sent to members on the municipal website.
allegations.key_passage: There is no requirement in the Open Meeting Law that a public body affirmatively provide copies of documents to persons in attendance at a meeting or that a public body include and post with a notice the documents it plans to discuss during a meeting.
